name: codeyoung-booking-server
description: Backend API for Codeyoung trial class booking system

scripts.postinstall: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); if(!fs.existsSync('.env') && fs.existsSync('../.env.example')) { fs.copyFileSync('../.env.example', '.env'); console.log('[Server] Created .env from ../.env.example'); }"
